archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (High-Focus Academic Command Center)
design_direction: Modern, sleek Dark-themed EdTech LMS with high-clarity typography, tactical live-exam HUD, fluid animated step-by-step tutorial viewer, split-pane PDF homework submission & grading desk, live presence indicators, and interactive real-time chat workspace.

rules.labels: font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-medium

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value & quick demo credentials left, live animated curriculum cards & live exam radar right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — LMS platform highlights & quick demo switcher left, role-based auth form right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split register — student/teacher feature preview left, multi-step signup card right

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Bento Grid (Mode B) with collapsible sidebar navigation, top command bar with session pulse, quick actions and multi-tab resource views.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Full responsive drawer sidebar on screens <1024px, bottom sticky toolbar for live exam timer and chat actions, optimized touch targets (min 44px).
grids_and_layouts.exam_screen_layout: Full-focus split view — Fixed top HUD (live clock, server sync indicator, question progress map) + center question card + right-hand question matrix navigator (mobile: bottom drawer sheet).
grids_and_layouts.homework_desk_layout: Split workspace: Left 50% interactive PDF document previewer / submission uploader, Right 50% rubric, grading form, rubric sliders, teacher feedback log, and student response history.
grids_and_layouts.chat_layout: Three-column modular messenger: Channel/DM sidebar (with live online presence dots) + Active thread pane + Thread details & shared attachments drawer.

transitions.step_tutorial: motion.div layout transition with smooth slide-in opacity fade (duration 0.3s)

motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; instant state toggling fallback when user prefers reduced motion.

accessibility.target_contrast: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum on all text, 3:1 on large HUD displays)
accessibility.data_testids: Strict role-based kebab-case testids required on all buttons, forms, timers, and submission handlers.

live_exam_room.name: LiveExamRoom
features: Synchronized server-time countdown clock (auto-submits when remaining time = 0)
Lockout enforcement: exam unlocks strictly at scheduled start timestamp
MCQ single-choice and multi-choice responsive selector
Question quick-jump matrix (answered / flagged / unanswered counters)
Anti-tamper full-screen focus guard warning indicator
Auto-grading report modal upon completion

animated_tutorial_player.name: AnimatedTutorialPlayer
features: In-app dynamic interactive step-by-step canvas/motion viewer (e.g., Algorithm visualization, Math graphs, Physics trajectory)
Embedded video lecture player (supports YouTube embeds + animated slides)
Play/Pause/Step-forward/Step-backward interactive controls
Step progress timeline with completion markers and bookmarking

homework_submission_and_grading.name: HomeworkDesk
features: Student PDF file uploader with drag-and-drop & in-browser previewer
Teacher grading panel with score slider, rubric badges, and rich feedback comments
Status badges: Pending Submission, Submitted, Under Review, Graded
Subscription gate barrier with mock Stripe test-mode upgrade modal

chat_workspace.name: ChatWorkspace
features: 1:1 Direct messages between student and teacher
Group course cohort discussion channels
Real-time polling engine with typing indicator simulation
Unread badge count and file attachment preview

admin_active_users_radar.name: AdminActiveUsersRadar
features: Live active user heartbeat dashboard with online status indicator
Role breakdown (Student / Teacher / Admin counts)
Subscription tier manager (Free vs Pro/Active Subscriber status)
Real-time session table with IP/device badge and last-ping counter

subscription_modal.name: SubscriptionPaywallModal
features: Pricing tiers for Student ($9/mo) and Teacher Pro ($29/mo) or INR ₹799 / ₹2,499 equivalent
Stripe test card autofill button (e.g. 4242 4242...)
Feature unlock breakdown (unlimited live exams, PDF grading desk, priority 1:1 chat)
Instant mock checkout success handler with active badge update

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend at /app/backend, Vite React 19 frontend at /app/frontend).
Configure dark mode styling in frontend/src/index.css with @import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk' and @import '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans' for crisp, premium dark EdTech aesthetics.

Implement seed data with pre-populated accounts (Student, Teacher, Admin), existing homework assignments with uploaded sample PDF links, scheduled live exams (one starting in 2 minutes for testing countdown, one ongoing, one past), interactive step tutorials, and active chat channels.
Ensure the live exam countdown is synchronized with server time and auto-submits on timer expiration.
Ensure homework evaluation lets teachers view the student's submission PDF, enter numeric grade (0-100) + feedback text, and updates the student's gradebook view instantly.
In the Admin dashboard, include a live heartbeat mechanism (client pings /api/auth/heartbeat every 15s) so the active users table accurately displays who is currently online.

Include subscription gating: when an unsubscribed student tries to take an exam or submit homework, or unsubscribed teacher grades homework, display the SubscriptionPaywallModal with Stripe test checkout simulation.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and status labels.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use generous Tailwind spacing (p-4, p-6, p-8) and keep container paddings intact.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Use specific transition-colors or transition-transform.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_raw_emojis_for_icons: Use lucide-react icons for all UI elements (e.g., BookOpen, Clock, FileText, CheckCircle2, MessageSquare, ShieldAlert, Users, Award).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use sonner toast for notification feedback on homework submit, grade save, exam start, and chat messages.
